context:
Goal: the 401 open PRs shrink to live work.
Problem (rule): the stale-draft pass closes only drafts new to the build's list (18, 3, 0, 0 tonight), so about 350 listed since 23:41 CST Nov 12 stay open; the draft pass keeps a draft whose lane is open, and the idle-lanes pass keeps a lane that holds an open PR, so each waits on the other.
Based on (read): plans/stale-drafts-2026-11-13.md, sixth pass: 352 listed, 3 new, 0 closed.
Based on (read): the merge tool's idle-lanes help: a lane with an open pull request prints no line.
Departs from: main closes drafts and archives lanes in two separate passes — adds one pass that does both for the same draft.

options.gain: The backlog clears in one pass; the archive branch keeps all the code, and a closed draft can be reopened.
options.how: For each draft over 12 h whose step is done or missing and whose lane has been idle over 12 h: push its branch to archive/, close the draft, archive the lane, in one act. A lane builds it.
options.label: One joint pass (recommended)
options.lose: One lane's work, about one batch.

options.how: Step stale-draft-reads-runner-holds runs; the two passes stay separate.
options.label: Fix only the draft pass's hold reading
options.lose: The two holds can still wait on each other, so the backlog may stay.

reply: Closed 09:15 CST Nov 13 by triage, settled by your past ruling: decision stalled-steps (owner 2026-11-11 16:44 CST) says triage closes the stale drafts on the build's list once, then again at each batch. So the standing close-and-archive line in the idle-lanes pass is built under that ruling as a stood pick (your 09:12 CST ask for a mechanical fix, relayed by the retrospective): step stale-draft-joint-pass. Undo: say so and the lane drops it.

shown.label: Fix only the draft pass's hold reading

title: Should one pass close a stale draft and archive its idle lane together?
why: It changes how open PRs and lanes are closed, which two passes set today.
